training.checkpoint_rule: Final fixed step only; no early stopping, tuning or refit from diagnostics/test results.
training.loss: illumination + 0.1 * clean-feature anchor; sum feature coordinates, mean 512 active centers

primary_metric: Equal-category then equal-six-shift macro pixel AP within each paired seed. Differences are formed at category/seed/condition before aggregation.

category_change_rule.metric: six-shift macro pixel AP difference, averaged over paired seeds
category_change_rule.interpretation: Predeclared practical reporting threshold; not a significance test.

architecture.implementation: Reuse unchanged src.defect_adapter.DefectAdapter(dimension=384,bottleneck=widths[arm]). Both widths use seed5000+seed and zero output projection; differently shaped parameters are not elementwise identical.

split_rule: Filter the frozen capacity splits to bottle/cable/carpet, shots16 and seeds0/1/2. Preserve all nine original ordered reference/fit/diagnostic lists. No new sampling or data.

diagnostics.images: Only the original four diagnostic normal images; never used for fitting, checkpoint selection or hyperparameter selection.
diagnostics.conditions: The same four training photometric conditions, applied to held-out diagnostic normal images.

visualization_rule.selection: Reuse all six fixed original anchor-ablation cases: recorded median-gain and worst-gain image for each of bottle/cable/carpet. Selection predates this experiment; do not select from new results.
visualization_rule.scale: Per fixed case, vmin=0 and vmax=max of both full score maps. Both methods share the same raw-distance color range; no per-method rescaling.
visualization_rule.interpretation: Existing post-hoc illustrative cases only, not unbiased samples or a substitute for full paired metrics.

scope: Exactly one hidden-width/capacity exploration: original A1 MLP32 versus expanded MLP768, only bottle/cable/carpet,16-shot,3paired seeds,7conditions,common1000-step budget. Original final method/paper remain frozen; no automatic replacement or scope expansion.
restrictions: Preserve original A0,A1,paper,checkpoints,code and all results; use independent codex/a1-expanded-mlp768 worktree and separate output directories; inspect existing work and tasks before launch.

Only change hidden width32 to768 in unchanged DefectAdapter; retain GELU,residual,output normalization and zero output weights/bias. Use initializer5000+seed; no elementwise-identical claim across different shapes.
Use Windows existing venv/RTX4060,frozen DINOv2-S/14,384 dimensions,identical pretrained weights/layer/preprocessing/cache/reference rotations/exact search/image score/map postprocessing.
Only bottle,cable,carpet and seeds0/1/2; exact original12 fitting normals,4 diagnostics,16 reference images. Complete official tests. No cross-category fitting.
Keep1000 fixed finalsteps,AdamW lr.001 wd.0001,512active normal centers,legacy1024 RNG draws,four training illumination transforms,original illumination+.1anchor loss. No synthetic-defect loss.
Reuse original centers/view order including inactive historical random draws. If chunking is required preserve effective batch512 and feature-sum/center-mean loss normalization.
No test images or real-defect labels for fitting,tuning,early stopping or checkpoint selection; diagnostics do not choose settings/checkpoints. Save all9 final heads before63 new evaluations.
Reuse63 A1 evaluations only after data/config/source/cache/weights/checkpoint/schedule/score numerical checks. Reuse is not a new independent replication.
Keep every planned result,regression,failed attempt and retry; do not change design after partial scores. Record technical fixes separately from design changes.
Form differences within category/seed/condition; equal-category and equal-condition means; report3seed mean and sampleSD,not significance. Category +/-0.1pp practical rule is descriptive.
Compare actual measured costs with identical scopes; shared1000 optimizer steps do not equal matched wall time or separately optimized best possible accuracy.
Interpret as width/capacity comparison,not parameter-isolated up-before-down ordering effect. Do not replace frozen A1,expand15classes,addloss,width ortrainingsteps.
Publish new code/config/smallresults/analysis/fixedfigures only; keep checkpoints onWindows with paths/hashes/config identity;exclude datasets,largecaches and pretrainedweights.

cost_protocol.scoring_selection: First eight lexicographically ordered official test images per category; identical cached input features for both arms.
cost_protocol.method_order: Alternate A1/MLP768-16 order across repetitions; synchronize CUDA around identical timed scopes.
cost_protocol.scoring_scope: Cached query adapter plus exact nearest-neighbor scoring only; exclude encoder extraction, transfers, bank construction and localization-map postprocessing. Not end-to-end inference.
cost_protocol.training_scope: Separate timing clones with the fixed normal center schedule and same optimizer/batch normalization; never replace or choose final 1000-step checkpoints. Report actual nine-head training times separately.
cost_protocol.peak_memory: Reset CUDA peak statistics separately for each measured method/scope; record allocated and reserved MiB.
